title: Establish Minimal Immutable Trust Kernel boundary
audited_findings: Signature verification accepts any bytes whenever keyId is listed; the signature is not cryptographically checked.
Sandbox attestation returns success without querying a real sandbox provider.
Audit records live only in an in-process array and the kernel is not proven to initialize before every Cordis context.
salvageable_from_prototype: packages/kernel/trust-kernel/src/types.ts — type definitions are independently correct
packages/kernel/trust-kernel/src/invariant.ts — singleton pattern and immutability boundary are correct
packages/kernel/trust-kernel/tests/boundary.spec.ts — test structure is reusable but must add real crypto verification tests
must_rewrite: src/index.ts verifySignature() — must use node:crypto verify() with real public keys, not accept any bytes
src/index.ts verifySandboxAttestation() — must call a real attestation provider, not return hardcoded success
src/index.ts appendAudit() — must use durable storage (file-based hash chain), not in-process array
src/index.ts — must be wired into packages/boot/app-boot/src/index.ts before Cordis Context creation
main_chain_gaps: Trust kernel not initialized in real boot path
